file_header:
# ==============================================================================
# MACRO CONFIGURATION & USAGE
# ==============================================================================
# HOW TO ENABLE OR DISABLE MACROS:
# Klipper reads every active macro in this file (If enabled in "MacroBase.cfg"). To disable a specific macro 
# so it doesn't appear in your interface or load into Klipper, you must "comment 
# it out" by placing a hashtag (#) at the very beginning of every line for 
# that specific macro, starting with the [gcode_macro NAME] line.
# 
# To re-enable a macro, simply remove the hashtags from the start of its lines.
# ==============================================================================

# ==============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION INSTRUCTIONS: BOWDEN VS DIRECT DRIVE
# ==============================================================================
# To adapt these macros for your specific extruder type, adjust the "FAST_EXTRUDE"
# and "FAST_RETRACT" variables inside the macros below:
# 
# For Direct Drive:
# - Set FAST_EXTRUDE to roughly 30 to 50 (mm)
# - Set FAST_RETRACT to roughly 40 to 60 (mm)
# 
# For Bowden Setups:
# - Set FAST_EXTRUDE to the length of your bowden tube (e.g., 400 to 450 mm)
# - Set FAST_RETRACT to the length of your bowden tube + buffer (e.g., 450 to 600 mm)
# ==============================================================================

macros.name: Load_Filament
macros.description: Heats the hotend to the target temperature and loads filament into the extruder.
macros.raw_code:
#======================================================
# LOAD FILAMENT
#======================================================
# @DESC Heats the hotend to the target temperature and loads filament into the extruder.
[gcode_macro Load_Filament]
gcode:
    {% set TEMP = params.TEMP|default(200)|float %}
    {% set FAST_EXTRUDE = 450 %}
    
    SAVE_GCODE_STATE NAME=loading_filament
    M117 Loading Filament
    
    # Low Temp Check & Heat
    {% if printer.extruder.temperature < TEMP %}
        M117 Heating to {TEMP}
        M109 S{TEMP}
    {% endif %}
    
    M83
    G91
    G1 E{FAST_EXTRUDE} F1500 ; Fast extrude to the point the filament hits the hotend
    G1 E70 F300              ; Slower extrusion to move filament through hotend
    G1 E-5 F400              ; Small retraction to prevent oozing
    G90
    RESTORE_GCODE_STATE NAME=loading_filament

macros.name: Unload_Filament
macros.description: Heats the hotend to the target temperature and completely unloads filament from the printer.
macros.raw_code:
#======================================================
# UNLOAD FILAMENT
#======================================================
# @DESC Heats the hotend to the target temperature and completely unloads filament from the printer.
[gcode_macro Unload_Filament]
gcode:
    {% set TEMP = params.TEMP|default(200)|float %}
    {% set FAST_RETRACT = 600 %}
    
    SAVE_GCODE_STATE NAME=unloading_filament
    M117 Unloading Filament 
    
    # Low Temp Check & Heat
    {% if printer.extruder.temperature < TEMP %}
        M117 Heating to {TEMP}
        M109 S{TEMP}
    {% endif %}
    
    G91 
    M83
    G1 E10 F600               ; Small extrude to make sure filament is loose in the hotend
    G1 E-{FAST_RETRACT} F1500 ; Fast retract out of the PTFE
    G90
    RESTORE_GCODE_STATE NAME=unloading_filament

file_header:
# ==============================================================================
# MACRO CONFIGURATION & USAGE
# ==============================================================================
# HOW TO ENABLE OR DISABLE MACROS:
# Klipper reads every active macro in this file (If enabled in "MacroBase.cfg"). To disable a specific macro 
# so it doesn't appear in your interface or load into Klipper, you must "comment 
# it out" by placing a hashtag (#) at the very beginning of every line for 
# that specific macro, starting with the [gcode_macro NAME] line.
# 
# To re-enable a macro, simply remove the hashtags from the start of its lines.
# ==============================================================================

# ==============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION INSTRUCTIONS: LED NAMING
# ==============================================================================
# By default, these macros target an LED strip named "my_neopixel".
# Use your code editor's "Find and Replace" feature to change "my_neopixel" 
# to the exact name of your [neopixel] or [led] configuration section.
# If you have multiple strips (e.g., RGB_LED and RGB_LED2), simply duplicate 
# the SET_LED lines inside each macro to control both simultaneously.
# ==============================================================================

# ==============================================================================
# INTEGRATION INSTRUCTIONS: PRINT STATE MACROS
# ==============================================================================
# To fully utilize the dynamic LED templates (like PRINT_PROGRESS, EXTRUDER_TEMP, 
# and LED_PRINT), you must call them from within your printer's state macros.
# 
# Recommended placements:
# - PRINT_START: Add EXTRUDER_TEMP, BED_TEMP, or LED_PRINT to light up the printer.
#                Add PRINT_PROGRESS to initialize the progress bar.
# - PRINT_END: Add LED_IDLE, LED_OFF, or CLEAR to disable effects when finished.
# - CANCEL/PAUSE: Add LED_IDLE or CLEAR to stop the progress bar.
# - RESUME: Add PRINT_PROGRESS to resume the progress tracking.
# ==============================================================================

macros.name: LED_OFF
macros.description: Turns the configured LED strip completely off.
macros.raw_code:
#=====================================================
# LED_OFF
#=====================================================
# @DESC Turns the configured LED strip completely off.
[gcode_macro LED_OFF]
gcode:
    SET_LED LED=my_neopixel RED=0 GREEN=0 BLUE=0 TRANSMIT=1

macros.description: Turns the configured LED strip to solid red.
macros.raw_code:
#=====================================================

#=====================================================
# @DESC Turns the configured LED strip to solid red.

gcode:

macros.name: LED_PRINT
macros.description: Sets the configured LED strip to a medium white suitable for printing.
macros.raw_code:
#=====================================================
# LED_PRINT
#=====================================================
# @DESC Sets the configured LED strip to a medium white suitable for printing.
[gcode_macro LED_PRINT]
gcode:

macros.name: LED_IDLE
macros.description: Sets the configured LED strip to a dim purple for idle states.
macros.raw_code:
#=====================================================
# LED_IDLE
#=====================================================
# @DESC Sets the configured LED strip to a dim purple for idle states.
[gcode_macro LED_IDLE]
gcode:
    SET_LED LED=my_neopixel RED=0.2 GREEN=0 BLUE=0.2 TRANSMIT=1

macros.name: LED_CYCLE
macros.description: Cycles through a rainbow of solid colors.
macros.raw_code:
#=====================================================
# LED_CYCLE
#=====================================================
# @DESC Cycles through a rainbow of solid colors.
[gcode_macro LED_CYCLE]
gcode:
    {% set repeat_count = 4 %}
    {% for repeat in range(repeat_count) %}
        LED_RED
        G4 P100
        LED_ORANGE
        G4 P100
        LED_YELLOW
        G4 P100
        LED_GREEN
        G4 P100
        LED_TEAL
        G4 P100
        LED_BLUE
        G4 P100
        LED_PURPLE
        G4 P100
    {% endfor %}
    LED_IDLE

macros.name: WELCOME_ANIMATION
macros.description: Plays a dynamic startup animation sequence across the LED chain.
macros.raw_code:
#=====================================================
# WELCOME_ANIMATION
#=====================================================
# @DESC Plays a dynamic startup animation sequence across the LED chain.
[gcode_macro WELCOME_ANIMATION]
gcode:
    {% set led = "my_neopixel" %}
    {% set chain_count = printer.configfile.config['neopixel ' ~ led].chain_count|default(1)|int %}
    
    # Turn all off
    SET_LED LED={led} RED=0 GREEN=0 BLUE=0 TRANSMIT=1
    G4 P200
    
    # Chase effect across dynamic length
    {% for i in range(1, chain_count + 1) %}
        SET_LED LED={led} RED=1 GREEN=0 BLUE=1 INDEX={i} TRANSMIT=1
        G4 P50
    {% endfor %}
    
    # Pulse effect
    {% for _ in range(3) %}
        SET_LED LED={led} RED=0.2 GREEN=0 BLUE=0.2 TRANSMIT=1
        G4 P200
        SET_LED LED={led} RED=1 GREEN=0 BLUE=1 TRANSMIT=1
        G4 P200
    {% endfor %}
    LED_IDLE

[delayed_gcode Welcome]
initial_duration: 1
gcode:
    WELCOME_ANIMATION

macros.name: EXTRUDER_TEMP
macros.description: Sets the LED strip to visually glow based on the current extruder temperature.
macros.raw_code:
#=====================================================
# EXTRUDER_TEMP
#=====================================================
# @DESC Sets the LED strip to visually glow based on the current extruder temperature.
[gcode_macro EXTRUDER_TEMP]
gcode:
    NEOPIXEL_DISPLAY LED="my_neopixel" TYPE=extruder_temp MODE=glow TRANSMIT=1

macros.name: BED_TEMP
macros.description: Sets the LED strip to visually glow based on the current bed temperature.
macros.raw_code:
#=====================================================

[gcode_macro BED_TEMP]
gcode:

macros.name: PRINT_PROGRESS
macros.description: Sets the LED strip to fill up dynamically based on total print progress.
macros.raw_code:
#=====================================================
# PRINT_PROGRESS
#=====================================================
# @DESC Sets the LED strip to fill up dynamically based on total print progress.
[gcode_macro PRINT_PROGRESS]
gcode:
    NEOPIXEL_DISPLAY LED="my_neopixel" TYPE=print_percent MODE=progress TRANSMIT=1

macros.name: PRINT_SPEED
macros.description: Sets the LED strip to fill up dynamically based on live printer velocity.
macros.raw_code:
#=====================================================
# PRINT_SPEED
#=====================================================
# @DESC Sets the LED strip to fill up dynamically based on live printer velocity.
[gcode_macro PRINT_SPEED]
gcode:
    NEOPIXEL_DISPLAY LED="my_neopixel" TYPE=printer_speed MODE=progress TRANSMIT=1

macros.name: CLEAR
macros.description: Clears any active active LED templates/effects.
macros.raw_code:
#=====================================================
# CLEAR
#=====================================================
# @DESC Clears any active active LED templates/effects.
[gcode_macro CLEAR]
gcode:
    SET_LED_TEMPLATE LED=my_neopixel TEMPLATE=

macros.name: NEOPIXEL_DISPLAY
macros.description: Internal helper macro that maps LED templates to the neopixel chain.

macros.name: HEAT_CHAMBER
macros.description: Homes the printer, moves the toolhead safely to the exact center of your print volume slightly above the bed, and turns on both the heated bed (120°C) and the part cooling fan (100%).
macros.raw_code:
#=====================================================
# HEAT_CHAMBER
#=====================================================
# @DESC Homes the printer, moves the toolhead safely to the exact center of your print volume slightly above the bed, and turns on both the heated bed (120°C) and the part cooling fan (100%).
[gcode_macro HEAT_CHAMBER]
description: Heats up the chamber
gcode:
    {% set X_MID = printer.toolhead.axis_maximum.x / 2 %}
    {% set Y_MID = printer.toolhead.axis_maximum.y / 2 %}
    {% if "xyz" not in printer.toolhead.homed_axes %}
      G28
    {% endif %}
    G90
    G1 X{X_MID} Y{Y_MID} F3000
    G1 Z10 F500
    M140 S120
    M106 S255

macros.name: PARK
macros.description: Homes the printer (if not already homed) and parks the toolhead at a designated safe location.

macros.name: SHAPE_X
macros.description: Homes the printer (if not already homed) and runs the resonance testing sequence (Input Shaping) for the X axis to help eliminate ringing/ghosting in your prints.
macros.raw_code:
#=====================================================
# SHAPE_X
#=====================================================
# @DESC Homes the printer (if not already homed) and runs the resonance testing sequence (Input Shaping) for the X axis to help eliminate ringing/ghosting in your prints.
[gcode_macro SHAPE_X]
description: Input Shaper X
gcode:
    {% if "xyz" not in printer.toolhead.homed_axes %}
      G28
    {% endif %}
    SHAPER_CALIBRATE AXIS=X

macros.name: SHAPE_Y
macros.description: Homes the printer (if not already homed) and runs the resonance testing sequence (Input Shaping) for the Y axis to help eliminate ringing/ghosting in your prints.
macros.raw_code:
#=====================================================
# SHAPE_Y
#=====================================================
# @DESC Homes the printer (if not already homed) and runs the resonance testing sequence (Input Shaping) for the Y axis to help eliminate ringing/ghosting in your prints.
[gcode_macro SHAPE_Y]
description: Input Shaper Y
gcode:

    {% endif %}

macros.name: Z_PROBE_CALIBRATE
macros.description: Homes the printer, moves the probe to the direct center of the bed, and initiates Klipper's interactive PROBE_CALIBRATE tool to set your perfect Z-offset.
macros.raw_code:
#=====================================================
# Z_PROBE_CALIBRATE
#=====================================================
# @DESC Homes the printer, moves the probe to the direct center of the bed, and initiates Klipper's interactive PROBE_CALIBRATE tool to set your perfect Z-offset.
[gcode_macro Z_PROBE_CALIBRATE]
description: Calibrate Probe Z-Offset
gcode:
    {% set X_MID = printer.toolhead.axis_maximum.x / 2 %}
    {% set Y_MID = printer.toolhead.axis_maximum.y / 2 %}
    {% if "xyz" not in printer.toolhead.homed_axes %}
      G28
    {% endif %}
    G1 X{X_MID} Y{Y_MID} F3000
    PROBE_CALIBRATE

macros.name: PID_HOTEND
macros.description: Homes, moves the nozzle to the center of the bed near the surface, turns the cooling fan to 100%, and runs a thermal PID tuning cycle for the extruder. Uses the TEMP parameter or defaults to 200°C.

macros.name: PID_HOTBED
macros.description: Homes, moves the nozzle to the center of the bed near the surface, turns the cooling fan to 100%, and runs a thermal PID tuning cycle for the heated bed. Uses the TEMP parameter or defaults to 60°C.

macros.name: BUZZ_Z
macros.description: Oscillates the Z-axis stepper motor (moves 1mm in each direction 10 times) to verify correct wiring and rotation direction.
macros.raw_code:
#=====================================================
# BUZZ_Z
#=====================================================
# @DESC Oscillates the Z-axis stepper motor (moves 1mm in each direction 10 times) to verify correct wiring and rotation direction.
[gcode_macro BUZZ_Z]
description: Buzz test
gcode:
    STEPPER_BUZZ STEPPER=stepper_z
